description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to ingredients in a schema, providing methods for copying data from another result set, sorting, and filtering based on preparation status.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ResultSet::Ingredient
classes.description: A Perl class representing a ResultSet for ingredients, with methods to copy data from other result sets, sort, and filter ingredients based on preparation status.

methods.name: copy_from_rs
methods.description: Copies ingredients from another dish or recipe result set into this result set.

methods.name: prepared
methods.description: Filters the result set to include only ingredients marked as prepared.

methods.name: not_prepared
methods.description: Filters the result set to include only ingredients not marked as prepared.
